fichas.title: Window Arrangement and Interior
fichas.summary: Illustrated reference to window arrangements, window types, interior relationships, and visual protection. Examples show vertical and horizontal windows, rooflights, bay windows, full-length glazing, double glazing, and window treatments. Elevation examples relate window placement to views, furniture, and activities.
uses: Bring light deep into a room
Accommodate heating or media ducts at the window sill
